approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in HNK-LINGUAS project after review of DEC-L02-SEM-001..008.

decisions_requested.statement: Approve FIRST_PERSON_REFERENT as a required L02 curriculum function so learners can make self-referential statements with recovered Chokhmah content.
Approve SECOND_PERSON_REFERENT as a required L02 curriculum function for interview/dialogue use.
Approve LOCATION_INTERROGATIVE as a required L02 curriculum function for TAYOVAN/KALOVALA/PAROVAN and related place contexts.
Approve CONTENT_SELECTOR as a required L02 curriculum function for asking about study, work, travel, perception and other content without defining a universal WH translation.
Approve QUESTION_OPERATOR as a required L02 curriculum function while keeping interrogative grammar scoped and non-universal.
Approve REUSE_BEFORE_INVENTION and authorize exact mapping review of AN, EN, KUVAN, KU and KE before any new surface-form authorship.
Preserve VANUVALI and VANI as unresolved L02 source forms, with VANI residence meaning remaining scoped to L01 and not promoted into L02 historical/canonical meaning.
Confirm that the 16-slot Vocabulary allocation is curricular mathematics, not evidence that five historically missing HNK words must exist or be invented.
